aethelgard-engine.description: The vanilla-JavaScript engine behind Aethelgard: Chronicles of Fate, a single-player browser RPG.

aethelgard-games.description: Two free Aethelgard browser games — a visual novel (The Books) and a role-playing game (Chronicles of Fate).

aethelgardvn.description: Saga — a small, dependency-free visual-novel engine for the browser, built to make Aethelgard — The Books.

all4one.description: 551 portable Windows tools in one free .exe — file operations, hashing, PDF and Office batch jobs, media conversion, network diagnostics, registry helpers, disk cleaning and security audits. Zero installs, zero telemetry.

ambient-sound-studio.description: A private, offline ambient sound mixer in a single HTML file — 25 synthesised layers, 36 presets and WAV/Opus export.

app-builder.description: A shared build kit that compiles a static web app into a single-file portable Windows EXE and an Android WebView APK.

blinkcode-ai.description: Optical file-transfer PWA — compress a file into a File DNA container, paint it as SpectraCode colour matrices and recover it with a camera.

blinktransfer.description: Offline file transfer via animated QR codes — no internet, no Bluetooth, no cables.

bmi-bmr-tdee-macros-fluid-calculator.description: A single-file clinical calculator — BMI, BMR (Mifflin–St Jeor), TDEE, macros, fluids and body composition, with Indian and WHO BMI cut-offs and an English/Hindi/Gujarati interface.

boericke-repertory.description: Boericke's Repertory as a free, offline single-file web app — a searchable clinical repertory and repertorisation tool, compiled by Dr. Sohil Momin after Oscar E. Boericke, M.D. (1927).

cldr.description: A single tiny Rust binary that sits in the system tray, pops up on a keystroke and runs whatever you type — a sum, a path, an app or a search.

conqueror-os.description: A private, offline resilience workspace in a single HTML file — read, reflect, journal, track and review.

dance-fight.description: A single-file browser rhythm game where every fight move is a dance move, driven by the beat grid of your own track.

gentle-pediatrics-companion.description: A triage-first home companion app for a sick child — nine common childhood situations, a red-flag check and remedy orientation from the book Gentle Pediatrics.

hms.description: HHMS — a LAN-based hospital management system purpose-built for homeopathic hospitals and clinics, with a server-owned database and no cloud lock-in.

homoeopathic-materia-medica-repertory-js.description: Open-domain homoeopathic materia medica and repertory texts as app-ready JSON — 13 books (1840–1906), about 108,000 rubrics.

idle-city-ages-of-growth.description: A single-file idle city-builder that grows from a Stone Age village into a Fusion Age world-city.

lexora.description: LEXORA — Layered EXact-text Repository and Adaptive compression architecture: canonicalise text, then compress it with guaranteed byte-exact recovery (Phase 1 prototype).

lockhtml.description: PIN-protect or one-time-view any HTML file with AES-256-GCM — a cross-platform CLI plus a browser GUI that runs on any OS.

materia-medica-builder.description: Build your own materia medica and repertory — offline, private and yours to export.

matneo.description: An AI-powered digital products and automation platform — practical planners, templates, AI resources and offline browser-based tools.

mnemosyne-companion.description: A study companion for Mnemosyne Materia Medica — 100 polycrest remedies as poetic pearls, keynotes and spaced-repetition drills.

neo.description: NOVA — a statically-typed, compiled systems programming language whose compiler lowers to C, JavaScript, Rust and WebAssembly.

neon-engine.description: A code-only open-world game engine for the browser — no assets, no dependencies; every texture, mesh and sound is generated at runtime.

neon-games.description: Two free open-world browser games on the Neon Engine — Dead Zone (zombie survival) and Neon Police.

neon-runner.description: A retro auto-fire side-scrolling shooter — one self-contained HTML file. Move, jump and duck; the gun fires itself.

open-materia-medica.description: The classical homeopathic materia medica in plain language — 344 remedy portraits, with a free web edition and an offline Android companion.

read-live-transform-app.description: A companion PWA to Read. Live. Transform.: A Practical Reading of the Qur'an — read the verse, live the practice, keep the change.

remedy-relationship-explorer.description: An offline, single-file explorer for homeopathic remedy relationships, built from public-domain materia medicas (Boericke 1927, Clarke 1900, Hering 1879).

retro-strike.description: A complete retro third-person shooter in a single HTML file — a custom software 3D renderer and chiptune audio, no dependencies.

skills.description: Reusable, machine-consumable skills extracted from every drsamonline project — a categorised, self-updating catalogue.

skin-case-tracker.description: A private, offline skin-case tracker built on the HHMS dashboard (History, Habits, Mapping, Symptoms) with a 90-day pattern engine, from the book The Skin Is a Liar.

smartbill-app.description: A fast, serverless, single-page GST billing and invoicing app for Indian businesses, with local IndexedDB storage.

smartnotes.description: SmartNote Scheduler — AI-powered notes, reminders and scheduling: write in plain English and it files itself.

the-symphony-companion.description: A pocket PWA companion to The Symphony of the Present — the book's ideas as cards, its practices as a checklist, a breathing timer and a gratitude journal.

the_browser.description: Aetheris — an experimental C++ browser engine (not production-ready), built on a Ladybird/SerenityOS-derived codebase.

ttb.description: TinyToolBox — 590 tiny utilities bundled into one lightweight, offline-first browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari).

ultimate-windows-optimizer.description: A PowerShell and batch toolkit for documented, reversible Windows 10/11 debloat and performance tweaks.

unstoppable-mind-companion.description: An offline companion to The Unstoppable Mind — the book's key points, exercises, a 7-day challenge and flashcards.

whispering-body-first-aid.description: A home homeopathic first-aid companion of 30 remedies with a symptom finder, dosing guidance and emergency signs, in English, Hindi and Gujarati.
